description: Defines MainActivityViewModel class managing UI state for MainActivity, including user data and theme preferences, using Kotlin coroutines and dependency injection.

classes.name: MainActivityViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel that manages UI state for MainActivity, fetching user data and exposing theme-related properties.

classes.name: MainActivityUiState
classes.description: Sealed interface representing different UI states: Loading and Success with user data.

methods.name: shouldKeepSplashScreen
methods.description: Returns true if the current UI state is Loading, indicating splash screen should be shown.

methods.name: shouldUseDarkTheme
methods.description: Determines if dark theme should be used based on user data and system theme.
